task.title: [M3] Canonical pre-build approval and scoped invalidation
task.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M3
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M3-04
**Implementation status:** Implemented; independent QA_PASS. Acceptance supported by the execution evidence below.
**Responsible implementer:** Codex (aM3as9DCoQ7pMoO3V9XsDbL3q2j9pWjn). Independent read-only reviewer: forge_qa_reviewer /root/rsf18_independent_qa.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§2.3, 4.3–4.6, 5.2/E, 6/M3, 14
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Bind human review to exactly the composition visible before compilation.

**Scope:** Canonical visual composition digest, operator approve/reject/batch scope, dependency tracking and stale-review workflow.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Canonical pre-build revision covers source-content hashes, assignments, ordered layers, recipes/crops/transforms, timing/offsets/anchors, target/profile and preview semantics.
- [x] Only operator can approve/reject a displayed frame/view/action/batch with precise scope and digest; approval exists before output build hashes.
- [x] Changes affecting visual inputs invalidate only affected scope; equivalent inputs/unrelated rebuilds do not invalidate approval; save/reopen preserves valid review.
- [x] PARTIAL/UNVERIFIED preview yields explicitly provisional inspection, never faithful-runtime approval; native acceptance remains separate.
- [x] Unchanged structural-only imports may record NOT_REQUIRED under explicit policy; replacement artwork requires applicable review. Missing/stale approval prevents production readiness.

## Verification

Canonical digest equivalence and affected-only invalidation tests; operator batch/rejection/reopen flow; future build hash independence check.

Actual execution evidence follows. Original planning scope is preserved; all automated review decisions used isolated synthetic art, never private artwork.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-17 (M3-03; task ID j4bq4r7uxi9z6l378go7oomo)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** No auto-approval or aesthetic scoring.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence

- core/review.py: canonical pre-build basis extends existing ledger dependency/composition identity with exact ordered-frame context, target/profile, timing/anchor constraints and renderer/preview semantics. Closed packaged review-event/v1 schema; optional project history preserves compatibility.
- Service proposal reconstructs persisted current inputs; atomic exact-scope decisions and optimistic revisions reject stale/batch conflicts. History persists; generic saves cannot inject approvals. Ephemeral coverage projection preserves assignment revisions.
- Workbench presents exact scope, actual source-layer previews, lineage and basis/evidence hashes before explicit Approve/Reject. Layer/frame/view/action/explicit batch selections are supported.
- Provisional ordered source-layer review only, clearly PARTIAL; not compiled-animation/native/artistic acceptance. Unexecuted transforms cannot be approved or exempted. NOT_REQUIRED requires explicit unchanged-reference structural-only policy. export_ready=false.
- Python3.14.4: focused19 PASS, public318 PASS, private36 PASS, all exit0. Six schema checkers PASS; node syntax PASS. Final offline installed distribution318 collected, OK(skipped2 optional-dependency tests), repeated wheel hash/isolation/private-asset exclusions PASS. Python3.12/3.13 NOT_RUN unavailable.
- Actual Playwright MCP Chromium156.0.8078.73: coordinator and independent reviewer directly ran fresh synthetic journeys. Exact individual/batch approval, rejection, reopen, A/B/C stale with D retained, separate-context409 conflict, unexecuted translation block and prior RSF17 assignment/playback/comparison PASS. Zero unexpected JS/network failures. Expected422/409/409 negative responses.
- Final installed-wheel browser rerun project rsf18-1793352821184:1 APPROVED,3 STALE,44 UNVERIFIED,export_ready=false. No private artwork approvals. Missing synthetic source separately becomes STALE/unreviewable, exact bytes restored.
- Implementation manifest docs/evidence/rsf18/implementation-manifest.json SHA256 e2ae7746e00b1a54c3ac205a980f9bd9c5e24a406bf3dd6853345684cbe1d16f. Final installed browser wheel d7c46473d8acae0cfb0b66be25e685b488337b59bf45420fd99f0948edeaba9c. Reproducible sdist-derived wheel a4cb1f7d5a9d411c3d6d0fe93cbafb4614892919b8a5abb1f01878235e81e0ea (separate build route).
- Deterministic workspace repeated bytes equal, SHA256 0728a38e01ba7f9a01fcde56fcda6f5379c9ef535a738271efd2f30e67edae77. Review-event/occurrence bases in docs/evidence/rsf18/determinism.json.
- Accepted baseline386 files/no missing; seven existing paths changed incl generated SOURCES.txt, new bounded review implementation/tests/evidence. HEAD472b1d3f9e29630b505fc2b3b7315f6b4e00beba unchanged, no commits/push, private resources excluded.
- Details: docs/architecture/RSF18_REVIEW.md; docs/evidence/rsf18/VERIFICATION.md, QA_REVIEW.md, browser-release-results.json, synthetic-review-dialog-qa.png.

## Independent QA result (reviewer reports, coordinator syncs)

QA_PASS — configured forge_qa_reviewer /root/rsf18_independent_qa independently inspected live five criteria and ran current-source318 public,36 private,19 focused and six schema checks, all exit0. Reviewer directly executed Playwright MCP in fresh synthetic project rsf18-1793352647508; all seven journeys passed, no unexpected console/network failures. This improves RSF17 browser independence.

Evidence-projection metadata correction was included in reviewer current-source tests. Independent installed-browser run preceded that metadata-only correction; coordinator reran full final installed-wheel browser suite afterward. Packaging was coordinator-executed. No mandatory findings remain. Reviewer made no source/Kaneo edits or real-art approvals.

## Milestone gates and scope

M0_VERIFIED retained (S/I/N previous exact scope); M1 planning accepted; M2_PREVIEW_AND_DIAGNOSTICS_VERIFIED retained. M3_LOCAL_OPERATOR_WORKBENCH_VERIFIED follows RSF15/16/17 Accepted plus this QA_PASS and final acceptance read-back, documented in docs/evidence/rsf18/M3_GATE_PACKET.md. Synthetic explicit operator interactions verify review mechanics under current operator instruction; prior RSF17 private UI import/count/assignment evidence remains applicable. No actual real-art approval is inferred. M4 ingestion/M5 compilation and new native output evidence remain unimplemented. RSF19 not started.

m3_tasks.title: [M3] Safe local service and atomic project persistence
m3_tasks.description:
**Project:** RO Sprite Forge (oq6fp33cmdnwl5h0v48zcr3u)
**Milestone:** M3
**Stable plan reference:** RSF-v1.1/M3-01
**Implementation status:** Accepted (done); verified by independent QA Review.
**Responsible implementer:** AGY (ICJQmirJliEFAZN3jBl3ZitHCandT0FG). Independent reviewer: forge-qa-reviewer subagent.
**Source reference:** docs/architecture/RO_SPRITE_FORGE_COMPREHENSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_v1.1.md §§4.1–4.3, 5.4, 6/M3, 8
**Planning source SHA-256:** 5edfbebcdb47620c59a915e8874094f35092125dd0444b79468aa55a191a361e

## Problem and expected outcome

**Objective:** Expose core use cases safely to a local human workbench.

**Scope:** Small Python HTTP adapter, filesystem JSON/content-addressed storage, create/open/import/save/reopen, backups and service limits.

## Acceptance criteria

- [x] Default bind is loopback; enforce Host/origin validation and CSRF/unsafe-method protection from the first server implementation.
- [x] Imports/uploads have bounded sizes and isolated staging; reject traversal, symlink escapes, collisions, source overwrite and project-defined command execution.
- [x] Versioned manifests and blobs publish atomically with backups; refresh/reopen preserves source hashes, assignments and review records.
- [x] HTTP uses the same core validators/use cases as CLI with readable typed errors and no database/network service dependency in core.

## Verification

Local request/CSRF/origin and path-escape/upload-limit tests; interrupted-write/reopen checks and CLI/API behavior parity.

Record actual commands, environment/tool versions, exit statuses, artifact hashes and NOT_RUN blockers at handoff. No tests, approvals or native runs are claimed by this planning record.

## Non-goals and dependencies

**Dependencies:** RSF-10 (M1-04; task ID uzuir12040jroddz4idk8ahi); RSF-11 (M2-01; task ID gspmf9so83jbn57y0anhz522)

**Non-goals / gate qualifications:** No public/LAN listener, database, task tracker or new image/video ingestion.

Original Ragnarok artwork/GRFs and private fixtures stay outside public Git/deliverables. Use synthetic redistributable fixtures for public verification. Private fixture/tool availability must be checked during execution, never assumed.

## Implementation evidence

- Deliverables:
  - `src/ro_sprite_forge/schemas/project-v1.json`
  - `src/ro_sprite_forge/core/project.py`
  - `src/ro_sprite_forge/service/security.py`
  - `src/ro_sprite_forge/service/server.py`
  - `src/ro_sprite_forge/core/errors.py`
  - `src/ro_sprite_forge/cli.py`
  - `tests/test_project.py`
  - `tests/test_service.py`
  - `docs/architecture/RSF15_SERVICE.md`
- Verification commands & exit statuses:
  - `test_project.py`: Exit 0 (15/15 passed in 0.026s)
  - `test_service.py`: Exit 0 (17/17 passed in 0.555s)
  - Full public tests: Exit 0 (277/277 passed in 4.119s)
  - Audited private tests: Exit 0 (36/36 passed in 11.714s)
  - Wheel distribution check: Exit 0 (`DISTRIBUTION_CHECK_PASS`, 277 tests in isolated wheel install)
- Security & persistence invariants:
  - Loopback default bind (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `::1`); non-loopback rejected with `PERMISSION_DENIED`.
  - Host validation prevents DNS rebinding attacks.
  - Origin validation forbids cross-origin browser abuse; zero wildcard `*` CORS.
  - Cryptographically unpredictable 32-byte CSRF token required on all state-changing methods.
  - Content-addressed blob storage (`blobs/<sha256>`), path containment checks, symlink escape rejection.
  - Atomic manifest publication (`os.replace`) with `manifest.json.bak` backup and optimistic concurrency control.

## Independent QA result

Independent technical QA completed by `forge-qa-reviewer`: **`QA_PASS`**. All acceptance criteria verified, zero regressions across 277 public tests and 36 private fixture tests, clean wheel distribution. Task moved to Accepted.
